Good Italian cuisine and a refined restaurant.
Aug 2026 • Family
Excellent restaurant with an open kitchen and very elegant, located in the Fairmont hotel.
Portions are not very generous, but the carbonara and cacio e pepe are very good and quite in line with Italian cuisine. The pizza is not up to the standard of the restaurant, but it is still good.
Prices are not cheap for Hanoi, but considering the place, they are acceptable. About €100 with a Peroni and 2 San Pellegrinos.

Best Italian restaurant in Vietnam (and better than many others in Italy)
Jul 2026 • Couples
Italians with nostalgia for Italy, I sincerely advise you not to look any further. Bacco is the best Italian restaurant tried in Vietnam.

I think the photos are enough to understand what we are talking about. Pasta with lamb ragù and paccheri with 'nduja and burrata are out of this world. Pizza with excellent dough, and real mortadella that brings a tear to the eye for those who have been traveling for weeks away from home (I add that the prices, 350 for the pizza and 450 for the pasta, are more than reasonable for the quality and elegance of the setting).

Special mention for Federico Dellepiane (head chef), who took the time to chat with us despite the busy evening, and for the excellent service from Quynh. If it were possible to give 6 stars, we would have done so. We will return.

Chef Federico and Quynh will be delighted to hear your kind mention. Creating a welcoming experience, both through our cuisine and our service, is something we care deeply about.
